subject: general
question: The simple interest on a sum of money for 1(1)/(2) years at 10% per annum is Rs. 30 more than the simple interest on the same sum for 1 year at 12% per annum. Find the sum.
solution:
**Given:**

Time 1 (t₁) = 1¹/₂ years = 1.5 years

Rate 1 (r₁) = 10% per annum

Time 2 (t₂) = 1 year

Rate 2 (r₂) = 12% per annum

Difference in interest = Rs. 30

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × r × t) / 100

**Calculation:**

Let the sum be P.

SI₁ = (P ×
; 10 × 1.5) / 100 = 0.15P

SI₂ = (P × 12 × 1) / 100 = 0.12P

According to the problem:

SI₁ - SI₂ = 30

⇒ 0.15P - 0.12P = 30

⇒ 0.03P = 30

⇒ P = 30 / 0.03

⇒ P = 1000

**∴ The sum is Rs. 1000.**
